title: docs(console): teach a navigation visible that both validators accept
body:
Fixes #13276
Clause-②: no

## What

`content/docs/guide/console.md`, the "Expression Visibility" row of the console feature table, only. It showed `visible: "${data.role === 'admin'}"` on a navigation item with no `dataSource`. It now shows a CEL predicate over the roots the console's navigation evaluator binds:

> Show/hide navigation items with a CEL `visible` predicate over `current_user` and `features`, e.g. `visible: "'admin' in current_user.positions"`. A `visible` that reads `data` needs the entry to declare a `dataSource`.

The `${...}` spelling is gone.

## Why these names (measured on origin/main 8e649da7d)

- The nav `visible` evaluator (`navEntryVisible` / `useNavVisibilityAndReads` in `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`) evaluates over the `ExpressionProvider` evaluator, and binds `data` only for an entry with an API `dataSource` (objectui#13029).
- That evaluator's scope (`buildExpressionScope` in `packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`) is `current_user` (aliases `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user`) and `features`; there is no `app` root (objectui#8155).
- `buildExpressionUser` forwards `positions`, and `'admin' in current_user.positions` on a nav item is what `navItemVisibleEvaluated.test.tsx` already drives.

## One-off parse of the example (not committed)

Item `{ id: 'nav_accounts', type: 'object', label: 'Accounts', objectName: 'account', visible }` through `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0 `NavigationItemSchema` (from `@objectstack/spec/ui`) and objectui's `NavigationItemSchema` (`packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts`):

| `visible` | spec | objectui |
|---|---|---|
| `${data.role === 'admin'}` (old row) | REFUSE, custom on `visible`: "reads `data`, but the entry declares no `dataSource`" | ACCEPT (objectui#13076 not yet landed on this base) |
| `'admin' in current_user.positions` (new row) | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| `current_user.hasCapability('studio.access')` | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| `features.multiOrgEnabled` | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
